"""Builds the JSON view-models the frontend renders directly. Merges real
DataHub fields with stormchaser.sim's simulated forecast fields — every
payload marks which of its fields are which (see each function + README).
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import math
import time

from .. import sim
from ..app import AppContext


def fmt_price(p: float) -> str:
    if p >= 1000:
        return "$" + f"{p:,.0f}"
    if p >= 1:
        return "$" + f"{p:.2f}"
    if p >= 0.001:
        return "$" + f"{p:.4f}"
    return "$" + f"{p:.7f}"


def fmt_k(v: float) -> str:
    v = v or 0
    if v >= 1e9:
        return f"${v/1e9:.2f}B"
    if v >= 1e6:
        return f"${v/1e6:.1f}M"
    return f"${v/1e3:.1f}K"


def ticker_payload(ctx: AppContext) -> dict:
    sol = ctx.hub.major("solana")
    btc = ctx.hub.major("bitcoin")

    def spark_or(sym: str, seed_up: bool):
        real = ctx.hub.real_sparkline(sym)
        if len(real) >= 4:
            return real
        return sim.sparkline(sim.seed_of(sym), seed_up)

    mode = ctx.ui_state["mode"]
    health = ("RED · EXIT-ONLY" if ctx.ui_state["exit_only"]
              else "YELLOW · MANAGING" if ctx.ui_state["paused"] else "GREEN · FULL OPS")
    return {
        "type": "tick", "ts": time.time(),
        "sol": {"price": sol.get("price_usd", 0), "price_fmt": fmt_price(sol.get("price_usd", 0) or 0),
                "change_pct": sol.get("change_pct", 0), "sparkline": spark_or("SOL", True)},
        "btc": {"price": btc.get("price_usd", 0), "price_fmt": "$" + f"{btc.get('price_usd', 0):,.0f}",
                "change_pct": btc.get("change_pct", 0), "sparkline": spark_or("BTC", False)},
        "mode": mode.upper(), "paused": ctx.ui_state["paused"], "exit_only": ctx.ui_state["exit_only"],
        "health": health, "pending_approvals": len(ctx.db.pending_approvals()),
        "data_ok": {"coingecko": ctx.hub.last_poll_ok["coingecko"] > time.time() - 120,
                    "dexscreener": ctx.hub.last_poll_ok["dexscreener"] > time.time() - 120},
    }


def _token_view(ctx: AppContext, t: dict) -> dict:
    fc = sim.forecast(t["symbol"], t["address"], t["change_pct"], t.get("volume_usd"), t.get("liquidity_usd"))
    verdict_text, verdict_color, verdict_plain = sim.verdict_of(fc)
    av = sim.avatar(t["symbol"])
    blocked = fc["risk"] == "SEVERE" or ctx.ui_state["exit_only"] or ctx.ui_state["paused"]
    open_pos = next((p for p in ctx.db.open_positions(ctx.wallets[ctx.ui_state["mode"]]["id"])
                     if p["symbol"] == t["symbol"]), None)
    age_s = None
    if t.get("pair_created_at"):
        age_s = max(0, time.time() - t["pair_created_at"] / 1000)
    phase = sim.phase_of(fc, age_s)
    grade = "A-GRADE" if fc["confl"] >= 75 else "QUALIFIED" if fc["confl"] >= 55 else "BELOW 55"
    return {
        "symbol": t["symbol"], "name": t["name"], "address": t["address"],
        "price": t["price_usd"], "price_fmt": fmt_price(t["price_usd"]),
        "change_pct": round(t["change_pct"], 1), "mcap": t.get("mcap"), "mcap_fmt": fmt_k(t.get("mcap") or 0),
        "liquidity_fmt": fmt_k(t.get("liquidity_usd") or 0), "volume_fmt": fmt_k(t.get("volume_usd") or 0),
        "txns_buy": t.get("txns_buy", 0), "txns_sell": t.get("txns_sell", 0),
        "age": _age_str(age_s), "phase": phase, "avatar": av, "dex_id": t.get("dex_id", "?"),
        "risk": fc["risk"], "prob": fc["prob"], "dir": fc["dir"], "confl": fc["confl"],
        "conf": fc["conf"], "agree": fc["agree"], "window": fc["window"],
        "grade": grade,
        "verdict": {"text": verdict_text, "color": verdict_color, "plain": verdict_plain},
        "spark": [round(28 - v, 1) for v in sim.sparkline(fc["seed"], fc["dir"] > 0)],
        "blocked": blocked, "has_position": open_pos is not None,
        "url": t.get("url"), "pair_address": t.get("pair_address"),
        "chain_id": t.get("chain_id", "solana"), "audit": sim.audit_pcts(fc),
        "narrative": sim.narrative_meta(fc["seed"], t["change_pct"]),
        "stop": sim.default_stop_target(t["price_usd"], phase, grade)[0],
        "target": sim.default_stop_target(t["price_usd"], phase, grade)[1],
    }


def _age_str(age_s: float | None) -> str:
    if age_s is None:
        return "?"
    if age_s < 3600:
        return f"{int(age_s // 60)}m"
    if age_s < 86400:
        return f"{age_s / 3600:.1f}h"
    return f"{age_s / 86400:.1f}d"


def tokens_list_payload(ctx: AppContext) -> dict:
    views = [_token_view(ctx, t) for t in ctx.hub.tokens]
    n_qual = sum(1 for v in views if v["confl"] >= 55 and v["dir"] > 0 and v["risk"] != "SEVERE")
    n_block = sum(1 for v in views if v["risk"] == "SEVERE")
    return {"tokens": views, "glance": {
        "qualify": n_qual, "watching": max(0, len(views) - n_qual - n_block), "blocked": n_block,
    }}


# --- chart geometry (percent of the .chart-area box; y: 0=top, 100=bottom) ---
_PX0, _PX1 = 0.0, 70.0   # historical candles fill the left; forecast cone the right
_PY0, _PY1 = 5.0, 70.0   # price band (top of the box); volume subplot lives below
_VY0, _VY1 = 80.0, 98.0  # volume subplot band
_CONE_STEPS = 14         # forward projection steps
_EMA_PERIOD = 9


def _chart_series(seed: int, price: float) -> dict:
    """Candlestick OHLCV + EMA / linear-trend / forecast-cone / volume-subplot
    series, all pre-projected into the frontend's 0-100 chart-box coordinate
    space (see .chart-area / candleChartHtml). Everything here is simulated —
    the cone is the analytic ± envelope a Monte-Carlo random walk converges to
    (deterministic, cheap), not real forecasting. See sim.py.
    """
    cds = sim.candles(seed, price)
    n = len(cds)
    closes = [c["c"] for c in cds]
    last = closes[-1]

    # log-return drift/vol of the historical closes → widening ± cone (~80% band)
    rets = [math.log(closes[i] / closes[i - 1]) for i in range(1, n) if closes[i - 1] > 0]
    drift = sum(rets) / len(rets) if rets else 0.0
    var = sum((x - drift) ** 2 for x in rets) / len(rets) if len(rets) > 1 else 0.0004
    sigma = math.sqrt(var)
    z = 1.28
    cone_mid, cone_up, cone_lo = [], [], []
    for k in range(_CONE_STEPS + 1):
        band = z * sigma * math.sqrt(k)
        cone_mid.append(last * math.exp(drift * k))
        cone_up.append(last * math.exp(drift * k + band))
        cone_lo.append(last * math.exp(drift * k - band))

    hi = max(max(c["h"] for c in cds), max(cone_up))
    lo = min(min(c["l"] for c in cds), min(cone_lo))
    span = (hi - lo) or 1.0
    py = lambda v: round((hi - v) / span * (_PY1 - _PY0) + _PY0, 2)
    cw = (_PX1 - _PX0) / n

    candle_vals = []
    for i, c in enumerate(cds):
        up = c["c"] >= c["o"]
        candle_vals.append({
            "left": round(_PX0 + i * cw, 2), "w": round(cw, 2), "up": up,
            "wick_top": py(c["h"]), "wick_h": round(max(0.4, py(c["l"]) - py(c["h"])), 2),
            "body_top": py(max(c["o"], c["c"])), "body_h": round(max(0.6, abs(py(c["o"]) - py(c["c"]))), 2),
        })

    # EMA over closes, centred on each candle
    ema, kf, e = [], 2 / (_EMA_PERIOD + 1), closes[0]
    for c in closes:
        e = c * kf + e * (1 - kf)
        ema.append(e)
    ema_pts = [{"x": round(_PX0 + (i + 0.5) * cw, 2), "y": py(ema[i])} for i in range(n)]

    # least-squares trendline over closes
    xs = list(range(n))
    mx, my = sum(xs) / n, sum(closes) / n
    den = sum((x - mx) ** 2 for x in xs) or 1.0
    slope = sum((xs[i] - mx) * (closes[i] - my) for i in range(n)) / den
    b = my - slope * mx
    trend = {"x1": round(_PX0 + 0.5 * cw, 2), "y1": py(b),
             "x2": round(_PX0 + (n - 0.5) * cw, 2), "y2": py(b + slope * (n - 1))}

    conew = (100.0 - _PX1) / _CONE_STEPS
    conx = lambda k: round(_PX1 + k * conew, 2)
    cone = {
        "up": [{"x": conx(k), "y": py(cone_up[k])} for k in range(_CONE_STEPS + 1)],
        "lo": [{"x": conx(k), "y": py(cone_lo[k])} for k in range(_CONE_STEPS + 1)],
        "mid": [{"x": conx(k), "y": py(cone_mid[k])} for k in range(_CONE_STEPS + 1)],
        "up_pct": round((cone_up[-1] / last - 1) * 100, 1),
        "lo_pct": round((cone_lo[-1] / last - 1) * 100, 1),
    }

    maxv = max(c["v"] for c in cds) or 1.0
    volume = [{
        "x": round(_PX0 + i * cw + cw * 0.15, 2), "w": round(cw * 0.7, 2),
        "y": round(_VY1 - (cds[i]["v"] / maxv) * (_VY1 - _VY0), 2),
        "h": round((cds[i]["v"] / maxv) * (_VY1 - _VY0), 2),
        "up": cds[i]["c"] >= cds[i]["o"],
    } for i in range(n)]

    return {"candles": candle_vals, "ema": ema_pts, "trend": trend, "cone": cone,
            "volume": volume, "hi": hi, "lo": lo, "split_y": (_PY1 + _VY0) / 2}


def token_detail_payload(ctx: AppContext, symbol: str) -> dict | None:
    t = ctx.hub.token_by_symbol(symbol)
    if not t:
        return None
    view = _token_view(ctx, t)
    fc = sim.forecast(t["symbol"], t["address"], t["change_pct"], t.get("volume_usd"), t.get("liquidity_usd"))
    ch = _chart_series(fc["seed"], t["price_usd"])
    stop, target = view["stop"], view["target"]
    wallet_id = ctx.wallets[ctx.ui_state["mode"]]["id"]
    position = next((p for p in ctx.db.open_positions(wallet_id) if p["symbol"] == symbol), None)
    buy_pct, tape = sim.order_flow(fc)
    # Real live chart: embed the token's own DexScreener pair (DexScreener's
    # chart is TradingView's charting library) — real OHLC, live to the second,
    # no API key. None if we don't have a pair address (then LIVE tab is hidden).
    pair, chain = t.get("pair_address"), t.get("chain_id", "solana")
    live_chart_url = (f"https://dexscreener.com/{chain}/{pair}"
                      "?embed=1&theme=dark&trades=0&info=0&chartLeftToolbar=hide"
                      if pair else None)
    return {
        **view,
        "candles": ch["candles"], "ema": ch["ema"], "trend": ch["trend"], "cone": ch["cone"],
        "volume": ch["volume"], "chart_split_y": ch["split_y"], "live_chart_url": live_chart_url,
        "max_price_fmt": fmt_price(ch["hi"]), "min_price_fmt": fmt_price(ch["lo"]),
        "entry_fmt": fmt_price(t["price_usd"]), "stop_fmt": fmt_price(stop), "target_fmt": fmt_price(target),
        "rr": round((target - t["price_usd"]) / (t["price_usd"] - stop), 1) if stop != t["price_usd"] else 0,
        "ensemble": sim.ensemble(fc), "checklist": sim.checklist(fc), "holders": sim.holders(fc),
        "audit": sim.audit_pcts(fc), "rsi": sim.rsi(fc), "buy_pct": buy_pct, "sell_pct": 100 - buy_pct,
        "tape": tape, "matches": sim.pattern_matches(fc),
        "pattern_annotations": sim.pattern_annotations(fc, ch),
        "chart_probs": sim.chart_probabilities(fc),
        "top_traders": sim.top_traders(fc),
        "dev_tokens": sim.dev_tokens(fc),
        "position": _position_view(ctx, position) if position else None,
        "similar": [_token_view(ctx, o) for o in ctx.hub.tokens
                   if o["symbol"] != symbol][:3],
    }


def _position_view(ctx: AppContext, p: dict) -> dict:
    cur = ctx.price_of(p["symbol"]) or p["avg_entry_price"]
    r = (cur - p["avg_entry_price"]) / (p["avg_entry_price"] - p["stop"]) if p["avg_entry_price"] != p["stop"] else 0
    rng = (p["target"] - p["stop"]) or 1
    entry_pct = (p["avg_entry_price"] - p["stop"]) / rng * 100
    cur_pct = max(2, min(98, (cur - p["stop"]) / rng * 100))
    av = sim.avatar(p["symbol"])
    sol_price = ctx.price_of("SOL") or 150.0
    value_sol = p["qty"] * cur / sol_price
    return {
        "id": p["id"], "symbol": p["symbol"], "qty": p["qty"], "avatar": av,
        "entry": p["avg_entry_price"], "entry_fmt": fmt_price(p["avg_entry_price"]),
        "stop": p["stop"], "stop_fmt": fmt_price(p["stop"]),
        "target": p["target"], "target_fmt": fmt_price(p["target"]),
        "current": cur, "current_fmt": fmt_price(cur),
        "value_sol": round(value_sol, 4),
        "r": round(r, 1), "entry_pct": round(entry_pct, 1), "cur_pct": round(cur_pct, 1),
        "held_since": p["opened_at"], "cost_basis_sol": p["cost_basis_sol"],
        "setup_note": p["setup_note"], "mode": p["mode"],
    }


def positions_payload(ctx: AppContext) -> dict:
    wallet_id = ctx.wallets[ctx.ui_state["mode"]]["id"]
    wallet = ctx.db.get_wallet(wallet_id)
    positions = [_position_view(ctx, p) for p in ctx.db.open_positions(wallet_id)]
    equity = ctx.portfolio.equity_sol(wallet_id, ctx.price_of)
    hist = ctx.db.equity_history(wallet_id, hours=24)
    day_start = hist[0]["equity_sol"] if hist else equity
    day_pnl_pct = ((equity - day_start) / day_start * 100) if day_start else 0
    open_positions = ctx.db.open_positions(wallet_id)
    deployed = sum(p["cost_basis_sol"] for p in open_positions)
    deployed_pct = max(0, min(100, deployed / wallet["starting_balance_sol"] * 100)) if wallet["starting_balance_sol"] else 0
    return {
        "mode": ctx.ui_state["mode"].upper(), "positions": positions, "count": len(positions),
        "balance_sol": round(wallet["balance_sol"], 3), "equity_sol": round(equity, 3),
        "day_pnl_pct": round(day_pnl_pct, 2), "deployed_pct": round(deployed_pct, 1),
        "panic": ctx.ui_state["panic"],
        "approvals": ([_approval_view(a) for a in ctx.db.pending_approvals()]
                     if ctx.ui_state["mode"] == "copilot" else []),
    }


def _approval_view(a: dict) -> dict:
    return {
        "id": a["id"], "symbol": a["symbol"], "setup_note": a["setup_note"], "grade": a["grade"],
        "risk_note": a["risk_note"], "size_sol": a["size_sol"],
        "entry_fmt": fmt_price(a["entry"]), "stop_fmt": fmt_price(a["stop"]), "target_fmt": fmt_price(a["target"]),
        "rr": round((a["target"] - a["entry"]) / (a["entry"] - a["stop"]), 1) if a["entry"] != a["stop"] else 0,
        "age_s": time.time() - a["created_at"], "ttl_s": 40,
    }


def journal_payload(ctx: AppContext) -> dict:
    wallet_id = ctx.wallets[ctx.ui_state["mode"]]["id"]
    trades = ctx.db.trades_for_wallet(wallet_id, limit=200)
    closed = [t for t in trades if t["side"] == "sell" and t["realized_pnl_sol"] is not None]
    wins = [t for t in closed if t["realized_pnl_sol"] > 0]
    win_rate = (len(wins) / len(closed) * 100) if closed else 0
    hist = ctx.db.equity_history(wallet_id)
    eq_pts = [{"ts": r["ts"], "equity": r["equity_sol"]} for r in hist]
    total_pnl = sum(t["realized_pnl_sol"] or 0 for t in closed)
    analytics = sim.journal_analytics(trades)
    return {
        "stats": {
            "trade_count": len(trades), "closed_count": len(closed), "win_rate_pct": round(win_rate, 1),
            "total_pnl_sol": round(total_pnl, 3),
            "avg_win_sol": round(sum(t["realized_pnl_sol"] for t in wins) / len(wins), 3) if wins else 0,
            "avg_loss_sol": round(sum(t["realized_pnl_sol"] for t in closed if t["realized_pnl_sol"] <= 0) /
                                  max(1, len(closed) - len(wins)), 3) if len(closed) > len(wins) else 0,
            "profit_factor": analytics["profit_factor"],
            "best_hour": analytics["best_hour"],
        },

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio

from .config import Settings
from .data.hub import DataHub

from .trading.copilot import Copilot
from .trading.exchange import PaperExchange
from .trading.portfolio import Portfolio

MODES = ("ghost", "copilot")  # AUTOPILOT intentionally does not exist — see exchange.py


class AppContext:
    def __init__(self, cfg: Settings | None = None):
        self.cfg = cfg or Settings()
        self.db = Database(self.cfg.db_path)
        self.hub = DataHub(self.db, self.cfg)
        self.portfolio = Portfolio(self.db)
        self.exchange = PaperExchange(self.db, self.hub, self.portfolio, self.cfg)

        self.wallets = {m: self.db.get_or_create_wallet(m, self.cfg.ghost_starting_sol) for m in MODES}
        self.copilot = Copilot(self.db, self.hub, self.exchange, self.wallets["copilot"]["id"])

        # UI-only session state, not money-shaped — fine to keep in memory.
        self.ui_state = {"mode": "ghost", "paused": False, "exit_only": False, "panic": 0,
                          "theme": self.db.get_setting("theme", "EVA UNIT-01"),
                          "scanlines": self.db.get_setting("scanlines", "1") == "1"}

        self._ws_clients: set = set()
        self.hub.subscribe(self._on_tick)

    async def start(self) -> None:
        await self.hub.start()

    async def stop(self) -> None:
        await self.hub.stop()

    def price_of(self, symbol: str) -> float | None:
        if symbol == "SOL":
            return self.hub.major("solana").get("price_usd")
        if symbol == "BTC":
            return self.hub.major("bitcoin").get("price_usd")
        t = self.hub.token_by_symbol(symbol)
        return t["price_usd"] if t else None

    async def _on_tick(self) -> None:
        self.copilot.maybe_generate()
        for mode, wallet in self.wallets.items():
            self.db.add_equity_snapshot(wallet["id"], self.portfolio.equity_sol(wallet["id"], self.price_of))
        await self._broadcast()

    def register_ws(self, ws) -> None:
        self._ws_clients.add(ws)

    def unregister_ws(self, ws) -> None:
        self._ws_clients.discard(ws)

    async def _broadcast(self) -> None:
        if not self._ws_clients:
            return
        from .api.viewmodel import ticker_payload
        payload = ticker_payload(self)
        dead = []
        for ws in list(self._ws_clients):
            try:
                await ws.send_json(payload)
            except Exception:
                dead.append(ws)
        for ws in dead:
            self._ws_clients.discard(ws)

"""DexScreener free API client (no key). Used only for the trending Solana
memecoin list — real symbol/name/price/change/mcap/liquidity/volume/txns.
Adapted from cryptodeck's client (which itself is adapted from solana-bot's
DEXScreenerPoller) — read-only, no trading capability here.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import httpx

from .ratelimit import TokenBucket

BASE = "https://api.dexscreener.com"


class DexScreenerClient:
    def __init__(self, rate_per_min: float = 55):
        self.bucket = TokenBucket(rate_per_min, burst=5)
        self.http = httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=15, headers={"User-Agent": "stormchaser/1.0"})

    async def close(self) -> None:
        await self.http.aclose()

    async def _get(self, path: str, params: dict | None = None):
        await self.bucket.acquire()
        try:
            resp = await self.http.get(f"{BASE}{path}", params=params)
            if resp.status_code != 200:
                return None
            return resp.json()
        except httpx.HTTPError:
            return None

    async def boosted_solana_tokens(self, limit: int = 20) -> list[str]:
        """Newest boosted-token addresses on Solana — a real "attention" feed,
        analogous to what the prototype calls DISCOVER/PULSE."""
        data = await self._get("/token-boosts/latest/v1")
        if not isinstance(data, list):
            return []
        seen, out = set(), []
        for item in data:
            if item.get("chainId") != "solana":
                continue
            addr = item.get("tokenAddress")
            if not addr or addr in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(addr)
            out.append(addr)
            if len(out) >= limit:
                break
        return out

    async def pairs_for_tokens(self, addresses: list[str]) -> list[dict]:
        """Batched pair lookup, <=30 addresses per call. Returns raw pair dicts."""
        pairs: list[dict] = []
        for i in range(0, len(addresses), 30):
            chunk = ",".join(addresses[i:i + 30])
            data = await self._get(f"/latest/dex/tokens/{chunk}")
            for p in (data or {}).get("pairs") or []:
                pairs.append(p)
        return pairs

    async def trending_solana(self, limit: int = 16) -> list[dict]:
        """Best (highest-liquidity) real Solana pair per boosted token."""
        addrs = await self.boosted_solana_tokens(limit=limit)
        if not addrs:
            return []
        pairs = await self.pairs_for_tokens(addrs)
        best: dict[str, dict] = {}
        for p in pairs:
            if p.get("chainId") != "solana":
                continue
            base = p.get("baseToken") or {}
            addr = base.get("address")
            if not addr:
                continue
            liq = ((p.get("liquidity") or {}).get("usd")) or 0
            if addr not in best or liq > ((best[addr].get("liquidity") or {}).get("usd") or 0):
                best[addr] = p
        return [self._trim(p) for p in best.values()][:limit]

    @staticmethod
    def _trim(p: dict) -> dict:
        base = p.get("baseToken") or {}
        txns_h1 = ((p.get("txns") or {}).get("h1")) or {}
        return {
            "address": base.get("address"),
            "symbol": "$" + (base.get("symbol") or "?").upper().lstrip("$"),
            "name": base.get("name") or "?",
            "dex_id": p.get("dexId") or "?",
            "price_usd": float(p.get("priceUsd") or 0),
            "change_pct": ((p.get("priceChange") or {}).get("h24")) or 0.0,
            "change_pct_5m": ((p.get("priceChange") or {}).get("m5")) or 0.0,
            "mcap": p.get("fdv"),
            "liquidity_usd": ((p.get("liquidity") or {}).get("usd")),
            "volume_usd": ((p.get("volume") or {}).get("h24")),
            "txns_buy": txns_h1.get("buys") or 0,
            "txns_sell": txns_h1.get("sells") or 0,
            "pair_created_at": p.get("pairCreatedAt"),
            "pair_address": p.get("pairAddress"),
            "chain_id": p.get("chainId") or "solana",
            "url": p.get("url"),
        }

"""DataHub — the only object that talks to market-data APIs. Polls on its own
loop, persists a short real price history (for sparklines), and fans ticks
out to WS subscribers. Read-only: this module cannot place an order.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import time
from typing import Awaitable, Callable

from ..config import Settings
from ..db import Database
from .coingecko import CoinGeckoClient
from .dexscreener import DexScreenerClient

TickCallback = Callable[[], Awaitable[None]]


class DataHub:
    def __init__(self, db: Database, cfg: Settings):
        self.db = db
        self.cfg = cfg
        self.coingecko = CoinGeckoClient()
        self.dex = DexScreenerClient()
        self.majors: dict[str, dict] = {}     # "bitcoin"/"solana" -> {price_usd, change_pct, sparkline}
        self.tokens: list[dict] = []           # trending Solana tokens (real fields)
        self.last_poll_ok = {"coingecko": 0.0, "dexscreener": 0.0}
        self._subs: list[TickCallback] = []
        self._task: asyncio.Task | None = None

    def subscribe(self, cb: TickCallback) -> None:
        self._subs.append(cb)

    async def start(self) -> None:
        await self._poll_once()  # warm the cache before serving the first request
        self._task = asyncio.create_task(self._loop())

    async def stop(self) -> None:
        if self._task:
            self._task.cancel()
            await asyncio.gather(self._task, return_exceptions=True)
        await self.coingecko.close()
        await self.dex.close()

    async def _loop(self) -> None:
        while True:
            await asyncio.sleep(self.cfg.poll_interval_s)
            await self._poll_once()

    async def _poll_once(self) -> None:
        markets = await self.coingecko.markets(("bitcoin", "solana"))
        if markets:
            self.majors = markets
            self.last_poll_ok["coingecko"] = time.time()
            for coin_id, row in markets.items():
                sym = "BTC" if coin_id == "bitcoin" else "SOL"
                self.db.add_price_point(sym, row["price_usd"])

        trending = await self.dex.trending_solana(limit=16)
        if trending:
            self.tokens = trending
            self.last_poll_ok["dexscreener"] = time.time()
            for t in trending:
                self.db.add_price_point(t["symbol"], t["price_usd"])
        self.db.prune_price_history()

        for cb in list(self._subs):
            try:
                await cb()
            except Exception:
                pass

    # -- reads ---------------------------------------------------------------

    def major(self, coin_id: str) -> dict:
        return self.majors.get(coin_id, {"price_usd": 0.0, "change_pct": 0.0, "sparkline": []})

    def token_by_symbol(self, symbol: str) -> dict | None:
        for t in self.tokens:
            if t["symbol"] == symbol:
                return t
        return None

    def real_sparkline(self, symbol: str, fallback_points: int = 24) -> list[float]:
        hist = self.db.price_history(symbol, limit=fallback_points)
        return [r["price_usd"] for r in hist]

"""Minimal async token bucket so free-tier APIs never see us as abusive."""
import asyncio
import time


class TokenBucket:
    def __init__(self, rate_per_min: float, burst: int = 1):
        self.interval = 60.0 / rate_per_min
        self.burst = burst
        self.tokens = float(burst)
        self.updated = time.monotonic()
        self._lock = asyncio.Lock()

    async def acquire(self) -> None:
        async with self._lock:
            while True:
                now = time.monotonic()
                self.tokens = min(self.burst, self.tokens + (now - self.updated) / self.interval)
                self.updated = now
                if self.tokens >= 1:
                    self.tokens -= 1
                    return
                await asyncio.sleep((1 - self.tokens) * self.interval)

acceptable in a trading UI, even a paper one: "Persist all state; a bot that
forgets its positions on restart cannot be trusted."
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import sqlite3
import time
from pathlib import Path

_DDL = """

);

    avg_entry_price REAL NOT NULL,
    stop REAL NOT NULL,
    target REAL NOT NULL,
    cost_basis_sol REAL NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('open','closed')),

);

    mode TEXT NOT NULL,

    qty REAL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('filled','rejected')),
    reject_reason TEXT,
    requested_price REAL,
    fill_price REAL,

    position_id INTEGER,

);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_orders_wallet ON orders(wallet_id, created_at);

    order_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES orders(id),
    position_id INTEGER REFERENCES positions(id),
    wallet_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES wallets(id),
    mode TEXT NOT NULL,
    symbol TEXT NOT NULL,
    side TEXT NOT NULL,
    qty REAL NOT NULL,
    price REAL NOT NULL,
    sol_amount REAL NOT NULL,
    realized_pnl_sol REAL,
    setup_note TEXT,
    ts REAL NOT NULL
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_trades_wallet ON trades(wallet_id, ts);

-- COPILOT approval queue. Approving/rejecting only ever calls the same
-- PaperExchange fill path GHOST uses — there is no wallet, no key, no RPC
-- call behind this table. See trading/exchange.py module docstring.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS approvals (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    symbol TEXT NOT NULL,
    setup_note TEXT NOT NULL,
    grade TEXT NOT NULL,
    risk_note TEXT NOT NULL,
    size_sol REAL NOT NULL,
    entry REAL NOT NULL,
    stop REAL NOT NULL,
    target REAL NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('pending','approved','rejected','expired')),
    created_at REAL NOT NULL,
    resolved_at REAL
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS events (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    kind TEXT NOT NULL,
    symbol TEXT NOT NULL,
    color TEXT NOT NULL,
    message TEXT NOT NULL,
    saved_amt TEXT,
    ring_pct INTEGER,
    ts REAL NOT NULL

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS equity_snapshots (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    wallet_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES wallets(id),
    ts REAL NOT NULL,

-- Short in-process price history for real sparklines (SOL/BTC + tokens),
-- built from what the hub actually polled — not fabricated.

    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_price_history_symbol_ts ON price_history(symbol, ts);

    key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    value TEXT NOT NULL

"""

SCHEMA_VERSION = 1


def _row_factory(cursor: sqlite3.Cursor, row: tuple) -> dict:
    return {d[0]: row[i] for i, d in enumerate(cursor.description)}


class Database:
    def __init__(self, path: Path | str):
        Path(path).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        self.conn = sqlite3.connect(path, check_same_thread=False)
        self.conn.row_factory = _row_factory
        self.conn.execute("PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL")
        self.conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON")
        self.conn.executescript(_DDL)
        if self.conn.execute("SELECT version FROM schema_version").fetchone() is None:
            self.conn.execute("INSERT INTO schema_version VALUES (?)", (SCHEMA_VERSION,))
        self.conn.commit()

    def close(self) -> None:
        self.conn.close()

    # -- wallets -----------------------------------------------------------

    def get_or_create_wallet(self, mode: str, starting_sol: float) -> dict:
        self.conn.execute(
            "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO wallets (mode, starting_balance_sol, balance_sol, created_at) "
            "VALUES (?,?,?,?)", (mode, starting_sol, starting_sol, time.time()))
        self.conn.commit()
        return self.conn.execute("SELECT * FROM wallets WHERE mode=?", (mode,)).fetchone()

    def get_wallet(self, wallet_id: int) -> dict | None:
        return self.conn.execute("SELECT * FROM wallets WHERE id=?", (wallet_id,)).fetchone()

    def set_wallet_balance(self, wallet_id: int, balance_sol: float) -> None:
        self.conn.execute("UPDATE wallets SET balance_sol=? WHERE id=?", (balance_sol, wallet_id))
        self.conn.commit()

    # -- positions -----------------------------------------------------------

    def open_positions(self, wallet_id: int | None = None) -> list[dict]:
        q = "SELECT * FROM positions WHERE status='open'"
        args: tuple = ()
        if wallet_id is not None:
            q += " AND wallet_id=?"
            args = (wallet_id,)
        return list(self.conn.execute(q + " ORDER BY opened_at DESC", args))

    def get_position(self, position_id: int) -> dict | None:
        return self.conn.execute("SELECT * FROM positions WHERE id=?", (position_id,)).fetchone()

    def create_position(self, **kw) -> dict:
        cols = ("wallet_id", "mode", "symbol", "address", "qty", "avg_entry_price",
                "stop", "target", "cost_basis_sol", "status", "opened_at", "setup_note")
        vals = tuple(kw.get(c) for c in cols)
        cur = self.conn.execute(
            f"INSERT INTO positions ({','.join(cols)}) VALUES ({','.join('?' * len(cols))})", vals)
        self.conn.commit()
        return self.get_position(cur.lastrowid)

    def update_position_qty(self, position_id: int, qty: float, realized_delta: float) -> None:
        self.conn.execute(
            "UPDATE positions SET qty=?, realized_pnl_sol=realized_pnl_sol+? WHERE id=?",
            (qty, realized_delta, position_id))
        self.conn.commit()

    def close_position(self, position_id: int, reason: str | None = None) -> None:
        self.conn.execute(
            "UPDATE positions SET status='closed', closed_at=?, close_reason=? WHERE id=?",
            (time.time(), reason, position_id))
        self.conn.commit()

    def trades_for_wallet(self, wallet_id: int, limit: int = 200) -> list[dict]:
        return list(self.conn.execute(
            "SELECT * FROM trades WHERE wallet_id=? ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT ?", (wallet_id, limit)))

    # -- orders / trades -----------------------------------------------------

    def create_order(self, **kw) -> int:
        cols = ("wallet_id", "mode", "symbol", "side", "sol_amount", "qty", "status",
                "reject_reason", "requested_price", "fill_price", "slippage_bps",
                "position_id", "created_at")
        vals = tuple(kw.get(c) for c in cols)
        cur = self.conn.execute(
            f"INSERT INTO orders ({','.join(cols)}) VALUES ({','.join('?' * len(cols))})", vals)
        self.conn.commit()
        return cur.lastrowid

    def create_trade(self, **kw) -> None:
        cols = ("order_id", "position_id", "wallet_id", "mode", "symbol", "side",
                "qty", "price", "sol_amount", "realized_pnl_sol", "setup_note", "ts")
        vals = tuple(kw.get(c) for c in cols)
        self.conn.execute(
            f"INSERT INTO trades ({','.join(cols)}) VALUES ({','.join('?' * len(cols))})", vals)
        self.conn.commit()

    # -- approvals (COPILOT — simulated, see module docstring) --------------

    def create_approval(self, **kw) -> dict:
        cols = ("symbol", "setup_note", "grade", "risk_note", "size_sol", "entry",
                "stop", "target", "status", "created_at")
        vals = tuple(kw.get(c) for c in cols)
        cur = self.conn.execute(
            f"INSERT INTO approvals ({','.join(cols)}) VALUES ({','.join('?' * len(cols))})", vals)
        self.conn.commit()
        return self.conn.execute("SELECT * FROM approvals WHERE id=?", (cur.lastrowid,)).fetchone()

    def pending_approvals(self) -> list[dict]:
        return list(self.conn.execute(
            "SELECT * FROM approvals WHERE status='pending' ORDER BY created_at"))

    def get_approval(self, approval_id: int) -> dict | None:
        return self.conn.execute("SELECT * FROM approvals WHERE id=?", (approval_id,)).fetchone()

    def resolve_approval(self, approval_id: int, status: str) -> None:
        self.conn.execute("UPDATE approvals SET status=?, resolved_at=? WHERE id=?",
                          (status, time.time(), approval_id))
        self.conn.commit()

    def expire_stale_approvals(self, max_age_s: float = 40.0) -> list[dict]:
        cutoff = time.time() - max_age_s
        stale = list(self.conn.execute(
            "SELECT * FROM approvals WHERE status='pending' AND created_at < ?", (cutoff,)))
        if stale:
            self.conn.execute(
                "UPDATE approvals SET status='expired', resolved_at=? WHERE status='pending' AND created_at < ?",
                (time.time(), cutoff))
            self.conn.commit()
        return stale

    # -- storm log events ------------------------------------------------------

    def add_event(self, kind: str, symbol: str, color: str, message: str,
                  saved_amt: str | None = None, ring_pct: int | None = None) -> None:
        self.conn.execute(
            "INSERT INTO events (kind, symbol, color, message, saved_amt, ring_pct, ts) "
            "VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",
            (kind, symbol, color, message, saved_amt, ring_pct, time.time()))
        self.conn.commit()

    def recent_events(self, n: int = 30) -> list[dict]:
        return list(self.conn.execute("SELECT * FROM events ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT ?", (n,)))

    # -- equity ------------------------------------------------------------

    def add_equity_snapshot(self, wallet_id: int, equity_sol: float) -> None:
        self.conn.execute(
            "INSERT INTO equity_snapshots (wallet_id, ts, equity_sol) VALUES (?,?,?)",
            (wallet_id, time.time(), equity_sol))
        self.conn.commit()

    def equity_history(self, wallet_id: int, hours: float = 336) -> list[dict]:
        since = time.time() - hours * 3600
        return list(self.conn.execute(
            "SELECT ts, equity_sol FROM equity_snapshots WHERE wallet_id=? AND ts>=? ORDER BY ts",
            (wallet_id, since)))

    # -- price history (real, for sparklines) --------------------------------

    def add_price_point(self, symbol: str, price_usd: float) -> None:
        self.conn.execute(
            "INSERT INTO price_history (symbol, ts, price_usd) VALUES (?,?,?)",
            (symbol, time.time(), price_usd))
        self.conn.commit()

    def price_history(self, symbol: str, limit: int = 60) -> list[dict]:
        rows = list(self.conn.execute(
            "SELECT ts, price_usd FROM price_history WHERE symbol=? ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT ?",
            (symbol, limit)))
        return list(reversed(rows))

    def prune_price_history(self, keep_hours: float = 6.0) -> None:
        self.conn.execute("DELETE FROM price_history WHERE ts < ?",
                          (time.time() - keep_hours * 3600,))
        self.conn.commit()

    # -- settings ------------------------------------------------------------

    def get_setting(self, key: str, default: str | None = None) -> str | None:
        r = self.conn.execute("SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key=?", (key,)).fetchone()
        return r["value"] if r else default

    def set_setting(self, key: str, value: str) -> None:
        self.conn.execute(
            "INSERT INTO settings (key, value) VALUES (?,?) "
            "ON CONFLICT(key) DO UPDATE SET value=excluded.value", (key, value))
        self.conn.commit()

"""Deterministic, seeded simulation for everything STORMCHASER's design shows
that has no real free data source in scope: forecast/confluence score, the
6-model ensemble, storm-risk checklist, holder/sniper/insider/bundler %,
deployer DNA, pattern-memory matches, sellability heartbeat, RSI, candlestick
history, order-flow tape, and storm-log events.

Every value here is a pure function of (token address/symbol, a coarse time
bucket) — same technique the original design prototype used (`rng(seed)` /
`getCandles`), just ported to Python. Nothing here claims to be real trading
signal; see README "What's real vs. simulated".
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import math
import random
import time


def seed_of(*parts: str) -> int:
    h = hashlib.sha1("|".join(parts).encode()).hexdigest()
    return int(h[:8], 16)


def rng(seed: int) -> random.Random:
    return random.Random(seed)


def tick_bucket(period_s: float = 4.0) -> int:
    """Coarse "live" clock — simulated values redraw every `period_s` seconds,
    same cadence as the design prototype's 1.4-2.6s state ticker."""
    return int(time.time() // period_s)


PHASES = ["LAUNCH", "DISCOVERY", "TREND", "GRADUATED", "DISTRIBUTION"]
RISKS = ["LOW", "MODERATE", "SEVERE"]
AVATAR_EMOJI = ["🐶", "🐕", "🐱", "🐈", "🐿️", "🐐", "🐸", "🦛", "🗿", "🐧",
                "🌧️", "🌪️", "📖", "💀", "❌", "🌘", "🎩", "🚀", "🧊", "🌕", "🤖", "🪙"]

META_NARRATIVES = [
    ("DOG SZN", "🐶"), ("CAT COINS", "🐱"), ("FROG META", "🐸"), ("AI AGENTS", "🤖"),
    ("MEME INDEX", "📊"), ("SOLANA CULT", "☀"), ("PUMP FUN", "🎰"), ("WHALE GAMES", "🐋"),
]


def phase_of(fc: dict, age_s: float | None) -> str:
    """Lifecycle phase used across Radar/Discover/Pulse."""
    if age_s is not None and age_s < 3600:
        return "LAUNCH"
    if fc["risk"] == "SEVERE" and fc["dir"] < 0:
        return "DISTRIBUTION"
    if fc["confl"] >= 65:
        return "TREND"
    if age_s is not None and age_s < 86400 * 2:
        return "DISCOVERY"
    return "GRADUATED"


def default_stop_target(price: float, phase: str, grade: str) -> tuple[float, float]:
    """Phase-aware default stop/target distances. Tighter for raw launches,
    wider for established A-grade trends."""
    if phase == "LAUNCH":
        stop_pct, target_pct = 0.015, 0.06
    elif grade == "A-GRADE":
        stop_pct, target_pct = 0.020, 0.12
    elif phase == "TREND":
        stop_pct, target_pct = 0.030, 0.10
    else:
        stop_pct, target_pct = 0.035, 0.09
    return price * (1 - stop_pct), price * (1 + target_pct)


def candles(seed: int, price: float, n: int = 48) -> list[dict]:
    """OHLC series ending near `price` — mirrors the prototype's getCandles()."""
    r = rng(seed * 7919 + 13)
    out = []
    p = price * 0.86
    for i in range(n):
        drift = 0.006 if i < 26 else (-0.004 if i < 36 else 0.007)
        o = p
        c = p * (1 + drift + (r.random() - 0.5) * 0.02)
        h = max(o, c) * (1 + r.random() * 0.008)
        l = min(o, c) * (1 - r.random() * 0.008)
        # relative volume, correlated with candle body so the volume subplot
        # spikes on the big moves (illustrative, like the rest of sim.py).
        v = (abs(c - o) / o + 0.003) * (0.5 + r.random())
        out.append({"o": o, "c": c, "h": h, "l": l, "v": v})
        p = c
    return out


def sparkline(seed: int, up: bool, points: int = 26) -> list[float]:
    r = rng(seed + tick_bucket(6))
    v = 15.0
    pts = []
    for _ in range(points):
        v += (r.random() - 0.48 + (0.03 if up else -0.01)) * 6
        v = max(3.0, min(27.0, v))
        pts.append(v)
    return pts


def avatar(symbol: str) -> dict:
    s = seed_of(symbol)
    hue = s % 360
    icon = AVATAR_EMOJI[s % len(AVATAR_EMOJI)]
    return {"icon": icon, "hue": hue}


def forecast(symbol: str, address: str, change_pct: float, volume_usd: float | None,
             liquidity_usd: float | None) -> dict:
    """Simulated confluence/verdict/risk/ensemble, loosely anchored to the
    real change% and liquidity so it doesn't feel totally arbitrary, but this
    is NOT a real trading model — see README."""
    seed = seed_of(symbol, address)
    r = rng(seed + tick_bucket(20))
    liq = liquidity_usd or 0
    vol = volume_usd or 0
    thin = liq < 8000
    coordinated = thin and abs(change_pct) > 150 and r.random() < 0.5
    risk = "SEVERE" if coordinated else ("MODERATE" if (thin or liq < 30000) else "LOW")
    dir_ = 1 if change_pct >= 0 else -1
    if risk == "SEVERE":
        dir_ = -1
    base_confl = 40 + min(35, abs(change_pct) * 0.5) + (10 if liq > 50000 else 0)
    confl = max(0, min(96, round(base_confl + (r.random() - 0.5) * 20)))
    if risk == "SEVERE":
        confl = min(confl, 12)
    prob = max(5, min(94, round(50 + dir_ * (confl - 40) * 0.6 + (r.random() - 0.5) * 10)))
    agree = 3 + (confl >= 55) + (confl >= 75) + (1 if r.random() > 0.5 else 0)
    conf = "HIGH" if agree >= 5 else ("MODERATE" if agree >= 4 else "LOW")
    windows = ["15-25m", "40-80m", "45-90m", "60-120m", "1-3h", "2-4h"]
    window = "—" if risk == "SEVERE" or confl < 40 else windows[seed % len(windows)]
    return {
        "seed": seed, "risk": risk, "dir": dir_, "confl": confl, "prob": prob,
        "agree": agree, "conf": conf, "window": window, "coordinated": coordinated,
    }


def verdict_of(fc: dict) -> tuple[str, str, str]:
    if fc["risk"] == "SEVERE":
        return ("DANGER — DO NOT ENTER", "down", "Coordinated-pump pattern detected in the simulated audit. Exit-only territory.")
    if fc["dir"] < 0:
        return ("EXIT / AVOID", "warn", "Structure reads bearish and memecoins are long-only here. Stand aside.")
    if fc["confl"] >= 75:
        return ("A-GRADE BUY SETUP", "up", "Trend, level and signal align in the simulated model. Full permitted size.")
    if fc["confl"] >= 55:
        return ("QUALIFIED — BUY THE RETEST", "up", "Setup qualifies. Enter on the signal candle at the level, never mid-air.")
    return ("WAIT — WATCHING", "dim", "Below the 55 confluence threshold. No trade until more factors align.")


def ensemble(fc: dict) -> list[dict]:
    names = ["CTB ENGINE", "MOMENTUM", "ORDER FLOW", "ON-CHAIN", "REGIME", "LIFECYCLE"]
    r = rng(fc["seed"] * 31 + 5)
    out = []
    for i, name in enumerate(names):
        agree = i < fc["agree"]
        dir_up = fc["dir"] > 0 if agree else fc["dir"] < 0
        p2 = round(fc["prob"] - 8 + r.random() * 18) if agree else round(30 + r.random() * 18)
        out.append({
            "name": name, "dir": "↑" if dir_up else "↓",
            "dir_color": "up" if dir_up else "down" if agree else "dim",
            "prob": max(8, min(94, p2)),
            "conf": "HIGH" if r.random() > 0.5 else ("MED" if r.random() > 0.3 else "LOW"),
        })
    return out


def checklist(fc: dict) -> list[dict]:

def storm_events(tokens: list[dict], n: int = 7) -> list[dict]:

    kinds = [
        ("LP PULL RACE", "down", "Coordinated pump classified ({w} wallets, uniform sizes, thin book). Entry locked — exit-only territory.", None, True),
        ("BLACKLIST", "down", "Bundled launch: {w} wallets funded from one source. Blacklisted before LP pull.", "~0.4 SOL", False),

def pattern_annotations(fc: dict, chart_series: dict) -> list[dict]:

def journal_analytics(trades: list[dict]) -> dict:
    """Aggregate journal stats by pattern, confluence band, and hour."""
    closed = [t for t in trades if t["side"] == "sell" and t["realized_pnl_sol"] is not None]
    if not closed:
        return {
            "by_pattern": [], "by_confl": [], "by_hour": [],
            "profit_factor": 0, "best_hour": None,
        }
    wins = [t for t in closed if t["realized_pnl_sol"] > 0]
    losses = [t for t in closed if t["realized_pnl_sol"] <= 0]
    gross_win = sum(t["realized_pnl_sol"] for t in wins)
    gross_loss = abs(sum(t["realized_pnl_sol"] for t in losses)) or 1e-9

    # Simulated pattern assignment keyed on trade ts/symbol.
    patterns = {}
    for t in closed:
        p = ["MOMENTUM", "RETEST", "BREAKOUT", "REVERSAL"][int(t["ts"] * 1000) % 4]
        patterns.setdefault(p, {"w": 0, "l": 0, "pnl": 0.0})
        patterns[p]["pnl"] += t["realized_pnl_sol"]
        if t["realized_pnl_sol"] > 0:
            patterns[p]["w"] += 1
        else:
            patterns[p]["l"] += 1
    by_pattern = sorted([{
        "pattern": k,
        "trades": v["w"] + v["l"],
        "win_rate": round(v["w"] / (v["w"] + v["l"]) * 100, 1),
        "pnl": round(v["pnl"], 3),
        "color": "up" if v["pnl"] > 0 else "down",
    } for k, v in patterns.items()], key=lambda x: -x["pnl"])

    # Hour-of-day expectancy (bucket ts into local hour).
    hours = {h: {"pnl": 0.0, "n": 0} for h in range(24)}
    for t in closed:
        h = int(time.strftime("%H", time.localtime(t["ts"])))
        hours[h]["pnl"] += t["realized_pnl_sol"]
        hours[h]["n"] += 1
    best_hour = max(hours, key=lambda h: hours[h]["pnl"])
    by_hour = [{"hour": f"{h:02d}:00", "pnl": round(hours[h]["pnl"], 3), "n": hours[h]["n"],
                "color": "up" if hours[h]["pnl"] > 0 else "down"} for h in range(24)]

    return {
        "by_pattern": by_pattern,

"""COPILOT — simulated manual-sign flow.

Real COPILOT (per the design spec) would build a transaction and hand it to
the user's own wallet (Brave extension / Phantom mobile QR) to sign; funds
stay in the user's custody. This build implements the UI language only —
"connect wallet", the QR placeholder, and the approval queue — but nothing
here can construct or broadcast a Solana transaction. Approve/Reject both
resolve through PaperExchange.execute(), identical to a GHOST fill. See
exchange.py's module docstring for why.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import time

from ..data.hub import DataHub
from ..db import Database
from .. import sim
from .exchange import PaperExchange

MAX_PENDING = 2
APPROVAL_TTL_S = 40


class Copilot:
    def __init__(self, db: Database, hub: DataHub, exchange: PaperExchange, wallet_id: int):
        self.db = db
        self.hub = hub
        self.exchange = exchange
        self.wallet_id = wallet_id

    def maybe_generate(self) -> None:
        """Surface a fake "signature requested" approval for a qualifying
        token, if the queue has room. Called on each hub tick."""
        self.db.expire_stale_approvals(APPROVAL_TTL_S)
        if len(self.db.pending_approvals()) >= MAX_PENDING:
            return
        for t in self.hub.tokens:
            fc = sim.forecast(t["symbol"], t["address"], t["change_pct"],
                              t.get("volume_usd"), t.get("liquidity_usd"))
            if fc["risk"] == "SEVERE" or fc["dir"] < 0 or fc["confl"] < 55:
                continue
            already = any(a["symbol"] == t["symbol"] for a in self.db.pending_approvals())
            open_pos = any(p["symbol"] == t["symbol"] for p in self.db.open_positions(self.wallet_id))
            if already or open_pos:
                continue
            fc = sim.forecast(t["symbol"], t["address"], t["change_pct"],
                              t.get("volume_usd"), t.get("liquidity_usd"))
            price = t["price_usd"]
            age_s = max(0, time.time() - t["pair_created_at"] / 1000) if t.get("pair_created_at") else None
            phase = sim.phase_of(fc, age_s)
            grade = "A-GRADE" if fc["confl"] >= 75 else "QUALIFIED" if fc["confl"] >= 55 else "BELOW 55"
            stop, target = sim.default_stop_target(price, phase, grade)
            risk_pct = 0.5 if grade == "A-GRADE" else 1.0
            self.db.create_approval(
                symbol=t["symbol"],
                setup_note=f"CONFLUENCE {fc['confl']} · {fc['conf']} CONFIDENCE · {fc['agree']}/6 MODELS AGREE",
                grade=f"CONFL {fc['confl']}", risk_note=f"{risk_pct:.1f}% RISK",
                size_sol=round(0.1 + (fc['confl'] / 100) * 0.4, 2),
                entry=price, stop=stop, target=target,
                status="pending", created_at=time.time())
            return  # one per tick keeps it readable

    def approve(self, approval_id: int) -> dict:
        a = self.db.get_approval(approval_id)
        if not a or a["status"] != "pending":
            return {"status": "rejected", "reject_reason": "approval not pending"}
        t = self.hub.token_by_symbol(a["symbol"])
        blocked = t is None
        result = self.exchange.execute(
            wallet_id=self.wallet_id, mode="copilot", symbol=a["symbol"],
            address=(t or {}).get("address", ""), side="buy",
            sol_amount=a["size_sol"], blocked=blocked,
            block_reason="token no longer tracked",
            stop=a["stop"], target=a["target"], setup_note=a["setup_note"])
        self.db.resolve_approval(approval_id, "approved" if result["status"] == "filled" else "rejected")
        return result

    def reject(self, approval_id: int) -> None:
        self.db.resolve_approval(approval_id, "rejected")

"""Portfolio bookkeeping — turns a fill into position/trade/wallet-balance
updates. No signing, no keys, no RPC: this only ever writes SQLite rows for a
paper wallet. See exchange.py for the fill path that calls into this.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import time

from ..db import Database


class Portfolio:
    def __init__(self, db: Database):
        self.db = db

    def equity_sol(self, wallet_id: int, price_of=None) -> float:
        wallet = self.db.get_wallet(wallet_id)
        balance = wallet["balance_sol"] if wallet else 0.0
        positions_value = 0.0
        for p in self.db.open_positions(wallet_id):
            px = price_of(p["symbol"]) if price_of else p["avg_entry_price"]
            positions_value += p["qty"] * (px or p["avg_entry_price"])
        return balance + positions_value

    def apply_fill(self, *, order_id: int, wallet_id: int, mode: str, symbol: str,
                   address: str, side: str, qty: float, fill_price: float,
                   sol_amount: float, stop: float | None = None, target: float | None = None,
                   setup_note: str | None = None, close_reason: str | None = None) -> dict:
        wallet = self.db.get_wallet(wallet_id)
        if wallet is None:
            raise ValueError("unknown wallet")

        if side == "buy":
            if wallet["balance_sol"] < sol_amount:
                raise ValueError(f"insufficient GHOST balance ({wallet['balance_sol']:.3f} SOL)")
            self.db.set_wallet_balance(wallet_id, wallet["balance_sol"] - sol_amount)
            existing = next((p for p in self.db.open_positions(wallet_id) if p["symbol"] == symbol), None)
            if existing:
                new_qty = existing["qty"] + qty
                new_cost = existing["cost_basis_sol"] + sol_amount
                new_avg = new_cost / new_qty if new_qty else fill_price
                self.db.conn.execute(
                    "UPDATE positions SET qty=?, avg_entry_price=?, cost_basis_sol=? WHERE id=?",
                    (new_qty, new_avg, new_cost, existing["id"]))
                self.db.conn.commit()
                position = self.db.get_position(existing["id"])
            else:
                position = self.db.create_position(
                    wallet_id=wallet_id, mode=mode, symbol=symbol, address=address,
                    qty=qty, avg_entry_price=fill_price,
                    stop=stop or fill_price * 0.965, target=target or fill_price * 1.09,
                    cost_basis_sol=sol_amount, status="open", opened_at=time.time(),
                    setup_note=setup_note)
            realized = None
        else:
            existing = next((p for p in self.db.open_positions(wallet_id) if p["symbol"] == symbol), None)
            if existing is None:
                raise ValueError("no open position to sell")
            qty = min(qty, existing["qty"])
            proceeds = sol_amount  # net after slippage + fee, set by exchange.py
            cost_share = existing["cost_basis_sol"] * (qty / existing["qty"]) if existing["qty"] else 0
            realized = proceeds - cost_share
            self.db.set_wallet_balance(wallet_id, wallet["balance_sol"] + proceeds)
            remaining_qty = existing["qty"] - qty
            remaining_cost = existing["cost_basis_sol"] - cost_share
            if remaining_qty <= 1e-9:
                self.db.close_position(existing["id"], reason=close_reason)
            else:
                self.db.conn.execute(
                    "UPDATE positions SET qty=?, cost_basis_sol=?, realized_pnl_sol=realized_pnl_sol+? WHERE id=?",
                    (remaining_qty, remaining_cost, realized, existing["id"]))
                self.db.conn.commit()
            position = self.db.get_position(existing["id"])
            sol_amount = proceeds

        self.db.create_trade(
            order_id=order_id, position_id=position["id"] if position else None,
            wallet_id=wallet_id, mode=mode, symbol=symbol, side=side, qty=qty,
            price=fill_price, sol_amount=sol_amount, realized_pnl_sol=realized,
            setup_note=setup_note, ts=time.time())
        self.db.add_equity_snapshot(wallet_id, self.equity_sol(wallet_id))
        return position or {}
